question: The Union Budget, 2020-21, allocated Rs. ________ crores for the Swachh Bharat Mission.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12,300.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Union Budget, 2020-21, allocated Rs. 12,300 crore for the Swachh Bharat Mission.**
 
• Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) is a nationwide campaign launched on 2nd October 2014 by PM Shree Narendra Modi that aims to free the country from open defecation (ODF).
 
• The Mission Coordinator for SBM is Secretary, Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation (DDWS), Ministry of Jalshakti with two Sub-Missions, the Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) and the Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban).
